purpose: Full Arabic MIRACLRetrieval BGE-M3 hybrid r100 ablation to test whether larger candidate/rerank depth improves over r50.

evaluator.method: Full-corpus dense+sparse candidate generation followed by FlagEmbedding BGEM3FlagModel.compute_score dense+sparse+ColBERT reranking.
evaluator.note: Same full-corpus setup as v33 r50, with doubled candidate and rerank depth.

interpretation: BGE-M3 hybrid r100 is the strongest completed full Arabic MIRACLRetrieval result in this repo, with main_score/ndcg_at_10 0.801025.
The gain over r50 is only +0.000234 nDCG@10, while rerank pairs doubled from 144,800 to 289,600 and rerank time roughly doubled.
This suggests the candidate/rerank depth is already close to saturated at r50-r100 for this setup.
The practical next step is not r200; it is a small dense/sparse/ColBERT weight ablation at r50 or r100, then teacher-data construction.
next_experiment: Run a small weight ablation, starting with a ColBERT-heavier configuration such as [0.3, 0.2, 0.5] at r50 to keep runtime controlled.
